content_sections.heading: About Civil Surgeon Office Dhanbad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: This recruitment is conducted by the Office of Civil Surgeon cum Chief Medical Officer Dhanbad under the 15th Finance Commission fund. Selected candidates will be placed at various UPHC-Polyclinics in Dhanbad including Shivpuri, Bhuli, Chandmari, Katras, Kolakushma, and Rajbadi Road Jharia on a contractual basis.
